==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I attained lucidity using my self induced sleep paralysis method, and returned to the superhero academy.

I analyzed the superpowered chip implants used by the school to figure out how they work.

I advocated for the school to outlaw powers that can manipulate tech, as those abilities are fundamentally too strong.
